summary.en: After accepting Kogoro's plan to bring White Spirits to Okuho Stables, Tokuyoshi organizes a procession to bring White Spirits to safety but, while on route, the horse disappears after the truck transporting it turns left in a construction site. They then learn that Masao Shiomi was the culprit and led White Spirits escape in another truck that was parked in the fake construction site because he was forced to. Someone kidnapped Shiomi's family and threatened Masao that if he didn't carry out the kidnapping plan, his family will be killed. They were then freed after the plan worked. A day later, a blanket that was used to cover White Spirits was found stained with blood by an anonymous tip. Was White Spirits really killed?
